Novoselytsya Jewish Cemetery (Russian side)

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivtsi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the cemetery of the historically 'Russian side' of Novoselytsya's Jewish community, divided from its 'Austrian side' counterpart, documented elsewhere in this collection, by the Rakitna River — a division reflecting the actual imperial border that once ran through the town. The Jewish population reached an extraordinary 86.1 percent of the town by 1930, supporting a Zionist organization, Magen Avraam, that drew more than 500 young members after 1917. On July 7, 1941, a pogrom claimed 975 lives on the day of the German-Romanian occupation.
